Name: ICON plc
Description:
Since our foundation in Dublin, Ireland in 1990, our mission has been to help our clients to accelerate the development of drugs and devices that save lives and improve quality of life. We do this by delivering best in class information, solutions and performance, with an unyielding focus on quality at all times.

We offer a full range of consulting, development and commercialisation services from a global network of offices in 53 countries. We focus our innovation on the factors that are critical to our clients – reducing time to market, reducing cost, and increasing quality – and our global team of experts has extensive experience in a broad range of therapeutic areas.

Name: Proseek Bio
Description: Addressing unmet diagnostic needs in women's health through new glycoprotein biomarker panel clinical mass spectrometry-based blood tests that are accurate, simple for patients and doctors, but sophisticated and cost-effective in the clinical laboratory.

Name: BSD Robotics
Description:
With a rightful 30 years reputation for designing and manufacturing BSD semi-automated punch instruments, BSD Robotics continues to develop high quality instruments that stand the test of time due to their long-term reliability and durability in the field. BSD’s commitment and investment in research and development ensures the ongoing advancement of technologies within the life science industries.

For life science laboratories who are looking to streamline their sample preparation processes, BSD Robotics provides customers with customized solutions that are both innovative and cost effective. BSD Robotics provides solutions to alleviate the challenges of procedural errors, traceability concerns and repetitive strain injuries experienced by many laboratories. Our BSD bio-sample punch instruments aim to promote productivity, reduce labour costs and increase sample throughput whilst offering comfortable operation and ease of use. 

Dedicated to the continual availability of spare parts, coupled with the support of experienced field service technicians around the world, BSD Robotics strives to provide the manufacturer’s highest level of support and service to all our customers. 

BSD semi-automatic punchers are used for a range of applications and can be customized to suit the specific requirements of the customer. BSD has an established relationship within hospitals, university research, and government agencies around the globe.

Applications:
•	Neonatal Screening
•	Human Identification (HID)
•	HIV Testing
•	Molecular Biology
•	Genetics and Proteomics
•	Drug Discovery
•	Food and Agriculture Testing
•	Pharmacogenomics
•	DMPK

Name: Anatara Lifesciences Ltd
Description:
Anatara Lifesciences is developing evidence-based solutions for gastrointestinal diseases in humans and animals.

GaRP is the working name for Anatara’s evidence based complementary medicines using unique formulations of bromelain, an enzyme extracted from pineapple stems along with other synergistic GRAS components. The combination and coating of these GaRP components have a beneficial effect on the physiology of the gastrointestinal lining, a positive influence on the microbiome (homeostasis & metabolites) and allows absorption of components in targeted areas of the gastrointestinal tract. GaRP’s multimodal activity provides a versatility for tailoring the components to various indications.

Human Applications

GaRP's human formulation is a microbiome-targeted multi-component complementary medicine that has been designed to address the primary underlying factors associated with gastrointestinal disorders such as IBS and IBD. Our formulation is positioned as an adjunct to existing therapies and is currently being tested in a double-blinded, placebo-controlled human clinical trial for safety and efficacy.

For further information on our human development plans, visit our webpage: https://anataralifesciences.com/products-pipeline/human-applications/.

Animal Applications

Anatara developed Detach for the control of scour (diarrhoea) in pigs which was approved the Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority (APVMA). Detach has been shown to reduce post-weaning diarrhoea and provide similar protection to antimicrobial agents, such as zinc oxide. 

BONIFF is a revised formulation of Detach that can be applied to dry feed for piglets after weaning for a simplified feeding process.

ANR-pf is a proprietary enriched formulation for poultry in water, providing a quick and flexible dosing method on-farm.

For further information on our Detach development plans, visit our webpage: https://anataralifesciences.com/products-pipeline/animal-applications/.

Name: Phrenix Therapeutics
Description:
A spinout company from Monash University and The Florey.

Funded by Curie.Bio in syndicate with Brandon Capital, Monash Investment Holdings, and Breakthrough Victoria.

Name: Genome & Company
Description:
Genome & Company is a global biopharmaceutical company that focuses on developing microbiome pharmaceuticals, consumer products and novel immune checkpoint inhibitors based on real-world clinical data and Multi-Omics analytic technology.

Since its establishment in 2015, as a global leader in the field of microbiome for immuno-oncology and novel drug discovery for immuno-oncology target, Genome & Company has been collaborating with global pharmaceutical companies, research institutions and hospitals in Korea based on the “Bed-to-Bench” approach (real-world clinical data driven R&D strategy) of GNOCLETM, a platform for discovering novel drug candidates.

Genome & Co strives to accelerate the development of innovative medicine to fulfill the medical unmet needs through microbiome therapeutics and novel drug target antibodies. 

지놈앤컴퍼니는 풍부한 임상데이터 및 다중오믹스 기술(Multi-Omics)을 바탕으로 마이크로바이옴 의약품과 신규 타깃 항암제 등을 중점 연구개발하는 글로벌 신약개발 전문기업 입니다.

2015년 설립이후, 지놈앤컴퍼니는 마이크로바이옴 면역항암제와 신규타깃 면역항암제 분야의 글로벌 리더로서 독자 신약후보물질 발굴 플랫폼 지노클(GNOCLETM)의 'Bed-to-Bench' 전략 (임상데이터기반 연구개발전략) 하에 국내외 주요 제약바이오 기업 및 연구중심병원과 협업해왔습니다.

Name: Tissue Repair
Description: Tissue Repair Ltd is an Australian biopharmaceutical company developing an advanced wound healing technology targeting applications in the chronic wound and cosmetic procedure markets. Tissue Repair has developed a unique active ingredient that is designed for wound healing and delivered topically. The biologically active pharmaceutical ingredient behaves like a decoy cell and simulates a yeast infection resulting in the stimulation of the body’s own wound repair pathways. This active ingredient also provides a platform for the opportunity to develop a range of products that have the potential to treat a broad range of conditions across the wound care market.

Name: Custom Science Australia
Description: Custom Science specialises in identifying and delivering best in class products and technologies for Genomics to the Australian Scientific community.

Name: GeneWorks
Description:
With over 25 years experience in the Australian Genomics industry, GeneWorks has a proud history of instrument and consumable sales and service, excellence in post sales support, and manufacture of bespoke isothermal nucleic acid assays here in Australia at our Melbourne facility.

More recently, our partnership with Alamar Biosciences and Quantum SI provides Australian and New Zealand researchers and clinicians access to the latest in ultra sensitive biomarker detection and Protein Sequencing.

In addition GeneWorks also proudly represents
- LGC Genomics - Genotyping reagents and services (KASP and sbeadex)
- Nippon Genetics - Molecular biology (Midori)
- OptiGene - Isothermal amplification technology (Genie Instrument and LAMP)

Our team of Scientific sales professionals, together with expert support and service engineering staff have a genuine passion for our mission to provide the latest instrument and reagent options to the Australian Biotechnology Industry.

Name: Identilab
Description:
Identilab is a 100% Australian-owned and operated DNA testing laboratory, purpose-built and located in Brisbane. With over 45 years of combined experience in forensic and human identification sciences, our expert team provides high-quality, confidential DNA testing services to individuals, families, government agencies, and legal professionals across Australia.

We specialise in accredited, human identification services, including:

 Parentage Testing – Clear, legally admissible answers in paternity and maternity cases.
 Immigration DNA Testing – Fast, reliable testing that meets Department of Home Affairs requirements.
 Kinship Testing – Determining relationships such as siblings, grandparents, and aunts/uncles.
 DNA Profiling – Ideal for personal records, estate planning, or high-risk professionals.
 Twin/Triplet Zygosity Testing – Scientific confirmation of identical or fraternal status.

We're accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 by the National Association of Testing Authorities (NATA), so you can be confident in the integrity, accuracy, and legal admissibility of every result we issue.

At Identilab, we combine scientific excellence with a personalised, client-first approach. We’re responsive, transparent, and committed to making DNA testing straightforward and stress-free - whether you're navigating a legal matter, an immigration process, or simply seeking clarity.

Based in Brisbane. Proudly working with government, legal, and private clients Australia-wide (and beyond).

Name: TechBio
Description: We are a Technology integrated Biology company for finding new perspectives of live and innovative biological technologies

Name: Fluent
Description: Fluent is pioneering the development of accessible brain-computer interface technology. Our mission is to seamlessly connect people with AI, enhancing communication and interaction for those with neurological conditions and ultimately transforming human-AI interaction for all.

Name: HA TECH
Description:
HA TECH Australia's largest RT-PCR (NAAT) and Rapid Antigen Test (RATs) Kit Manufacturer.
HA TECH is an Australian based Biotechnology company developing & delivering effective Diagnostic, Pharmaceutical products and innovative medical technologies.  
Exported millions of Australian made TGA approved products to over 25 countries since its inception. With the ability to produce 10 million antigen tests and 40 million RT-PCR tests per month, HA Tech holds the largest diagnostic manufacturing capacity in Australia.
In the last 3 years since 2020, the company has seen rapid growth, with more than 30 diagnostic products in the pipeline and being commercialized. 
Our focus is on the diagnosis of serious infectious diseases:  respiratory, including COVID-19, sexually transmitted infection (STI) and mosquito-borne diseases that affect hundreds of millions of people worldwide and are among the most urgent global health challenges.
HA Tech exported millions of COVID-19 test kits in Europe and Asia during the pandemic, comfortably becoming a winner of the 2022 NSW Premier’s Export Awards. The company is hard at work to setup a multi-use biotechnology production facility and aspires to be the premier Australian company to compete in the international arena by supplying locally made human insulin products.

Name: Skin2Neuron
Description: S2N’s vision is a world where neuronal loss no longer means loss.  Our regenerative medicine technology starts with the human hair follicle and ends with production of millions of pure neurons, all gene modification free. We aim to transform health, science and society.

Name: Biomolecular Horizons 2024
Description:
This important forum will bring together three prestigious congresses, each with a strong history of attracting the Bioscience and Biotechnology communities to discuss and examine the latest developments and research: 

•	26th Congress of the International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (IUBMB)
•	17th Congress of the Federation of Asian & Oceanian Biochemists & Molecular Biologists (FAOBMB)
•	22nd ComBio Conference (ComBio)

This will be the first time the IUBMB Congress will be held in Melbourne and only the third time in the Southern Hemisphere.  It will join with FAOBMB and ComBio to create a truly global forum bringing together renowned scientists from across the world, from Nobel Laureates to early career scientists.

The overarching theme of the Biomolecular Horizons 2024 (BMH2024) Congress is: Discover, Create, Innovate, which will be covered in twelve Program Themes. Over the five days, the Congress will offer a series of plenary sessions, keynotes, symposia, and poster presentations. There will also be a dedicated Young Scientists Program, Outreach Events, Career Development Events, Education Events, Publication Workshops, Technical Workshops, Art Meets Science and Networking Events and a Government Industry Forum.

The field of biomolecular science is progressing at a breath-taking rate, providing a molecular understanding of the natural world; and driving innovation in biology, medicine, nutrition, agriculture, physiology, genetics, and immunology.  

BMH2024 will be one of the biggest international research conferences in basic biomolecular science. It will disseminate new developments in research and education to members of the academic, research and industry communities, and more generally to the public.

You will have the chance to connect with colleagues from across the world exchanging ideas and research and building valuable professional networks that will extend beyond the Congress itself.

Name: SeaO2
Description:
SeaO2 is Australia’s leading marine environmental services company, 
dedicated to merge traditional marine construction skills with cutting 
edge marine science and engineering.

SEAO2 delivers projects and establishes standalone businesses whose primary purpose is to benefit the environment in a commercially sustainable way. 

Our approach is to seed multiple projects, prove viability, iterate, improve & scale.

Name: Centre for Population Genomics
Description:
The CPG is a team of researchers, software engineers, data scientists, and other staff working with communities and a large network of research and clinical partners to solve critical problems facing the adoption of genomic medicine in Australia.

The Centre was formed as a joint initiative between the Garvan Institute of Medical Research in Sydney and Murdoch Children's Research Institute in Melbourne. We operate as a single remote-first team, with team members in over 7 locations across Australia and New Zealand.

Name: UQ Agrifood Research Student Association (UQ ARSA)
Description:
UQ Agrifood Research Student Association (UQ ARSA) is a student-led organization supported by the UQ School of Agriculture and Food Sustainability (AGFS) and the Queensland Alliance for Agriculture and Food Innovation (QAAFI). We aim to enhance the academic, professional, and social experience of students engaged in agriculture and food research at The University of Queensland.

Our aims are:

To foster a strong sense of community among students across UQ’s agrifood research programs and centres.

To enrich the academic journey of undergraduate and postgraduate students through networking, events, and peer support.

To support UQ’s mission of research excellence by providing career development opportunities and promoting student-led initiatives.

Name: Synbiote
Description: At Synbiote, we strive to turn today's refuse into tomorrow's resources. Our vision is to transform processes across the industry from waste-creating to resource-saving. Through Biota360 and sörzero, our mission is to use biotech to improve the global welfare of both people and the planet.

Name: Warkiani Lab
Description: We are exploiting new physics using novel micro/nano-engineered systems for application in cancer management, bio-processing and medical diagnostics. Our research interests are unified by the drive to develop innovative biomedical tools that are ultimately able to traverse the gap from bench-side to bedside.

Name: Media City Scientific
Description:
Media City Scientific develops chemically defined, animal-free tools for cell culture.

Our first product, FRSTM Pioneer is a broad-spectrum replacement for fetal bovine serum that mixes directly into standard basal media and supports long-term growth of immortalised cell lines. Cell attachment is handled modularly via coatings or surface technologies, including our own broad-spectrum, chemically defined option.

We design products for scientists who want more control, consistency, and transparency in their cell culture systems, without forcing changes to established workflows.

Name: Systematic Medicine
Description: Just as statins slow the build-up of plaque in arteries, we’re working to slow the build-up of mutations in DNA — to extend healthspan and reduce cancer risk.

Name: GC CRO
Description:
Established in 2019 as an Australian based full-service CRO, we provide tailored clinical development solutions spanning the entire lifecycle of product development, with deep expertise in early phase oncology, radiopharmaceutical and imaging clinical trial requirements. 

GC CRO have an additional offering of an in-house imaging and dosimetry team (also known as the IRO) that consists of experienced imaging technologists and physicists. Rapid advancement in radiopharmaceuticals development presents notable clinical trial challenges that demand specialized expertise and innovative solutions. As radiopharmaceutical research evolves, the lessons learned and strategies we have employed in our past and current studies will serve as a valuable blueprint for future trials, ensuring that patient safety and data quality remain front and centre. 

Our team provides flexible clinical trial management services in Australia, New Zealand, China, Europe and the USA. We work with first in class vendors to provide high quality, tailored clinical development solutions.

Name: Integrated Sciences
Description: Integrated Sciences, established in 1983, is a privately owned Australian company specialising in the sale and support of Clinical Diagnostics, Molecular Diagnostics, Point of Care and Research products to the Australian and New Zealand markets. Our success has stemmed from our ability to understand our customers needs and partnering with innovative and reliable International suppliers. Our company motto "Our Strategy is Support" exemplifies our focus and recognises the support and skills of our staff in enabling our success.

Name: Maisha Earth Solutions
Description:
In the realm of Maisha Earth Solutions, we're tapping into the extraordinary gifts bestowed by Mother Nature herself. 

Picture this: a vibrant ecosystem teeming with dynamic fungi, orchestrating a symphony of communication underground. These fungi form an intricate web, linking the very roots of our plants in a dance of vitality, where nutrients and enzymes flow ceaselessly.

The magic doesn't stop there. We're talking about instant carbon sequestration, a whopping 10 tons per hectare, as if Nature herself has declared, 'Watch and learn!' 

This is not just innovation; it's a revolutionary dance with the Earth, a testament to the power within our grasp. Together, with the Maisha Earth Solutions (the Living Earth and Hydrated NanoClay) working in harmony, we're ushering in a new era of sustainable growth and ecological balance!

We then investigate Biochar, the unsung hero of agricultural innovation! Backed by thousands of scientific studies, its transformative powers are nothing short of extraordinary. Imagine soils revitalized, pH levels optimized, and precious nutrients and water locked in for maximum benefit. It's a soil-saving, fertilizer-slashing, greenhouse-gas-fighting superstar, all bottled into the Maisha Earth Solution.

Global crop lands have lost up to 60% of their organic carbon.

By ingeniously converting human solid bio sludge into Biochar, we're orchestrating a transformation of epic proportions: turning waste into a valuable resource. It's a metamorphosis that yields gold for us, and equally precious gold for the soil.

Enter the Maisha Earth Solution, armed with a dynamic two-pronged approach to water conservation. Our Hydrated NanoClay and Living Earth work in tandem, boasting distinct yet complementary water-absorbing superpowers. The result? A potential 70% reduction in irrigation water use, revolutionising how we steward this vital resource.

Name: Gelteq
Description:
We are a global biotechnology company specialising in ingestible gel technologies for humans and animals, covering the pharmaceutical, healthcare, nutrition & sport sectors. Our proprietary technology has been designed to assist with the delivery of APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients) or nutritional compounds via an easy to consume gel based formulation.

We provide a unique gel based technology for businesses who are looking to white label ingestible gel based solutions as an alternative to pills, powders and capsules.

Name: University of Melbourne Biotechnology Club
Description:
UMBC is a Biotechnology club for University of Melbourne students who are interested in all things Biotechnology.

Our aims include:
- To enhance the academic and professional lives of students interested in Biotechnology. 
- To promote interaction, welfare and cohesion between Biotechnology students. 
- To support the academic endeavours of members and to act as a representative group of Biotechnology students.
- To provide members with the opportunity to further cultivate their interest in Biotechnology

We look forward to providing you all with an experience rich with social, educational, and networking events/workshops with LOTS OF FUN of course!

Name: Wintermute Biomedical Pty Ltd
Description: Wintermute Biomedical is an antimicrobials-focused pharmaceutical company located in Melbourne, Australia and Missoula, Montana. We have developed a novel platform for harnessing the antimicrobial activity of fatty acids, with a focus on developing a next-generation treatment for Shingles. Our lead product SolexanTM is now in clinical trials. Our vision is to make SolexanTM available for the millions of people who fall victim to Shingles each year.

Name: Novoviah
Description:
At Novoviah, we make monitoring for rare antigen-specific T cells easy and sensitive for a clinical trial. 

Arising from our Founder’s 20+ years’ experience researching and studying celiac disease and inflammatory bowel diseases, Novoviah’s break-through foundation product is the proprietary Novoleukin Test System, a “whole blood antigen-stimulated cytokine release assay” which is substantially more sensitive than conventional fresh PBMC-based ELISpot assay and flow cytometry assays. 

Novoviah has demonstrated the success of the Novoleukin Test System as a ‘research only product’, firstly in Celiac Disease (Novoleukin-C, clinical validation stage); and is expanding to Type 1 Diabetes, and other medical conditions associated with antigen-specific T cells.

Novoviah’s aspiration is to have a Novoleukin Test System available for a wide range of antigens relevant to immune disease, immunotherapies and vaccines, and to explore their clinical utility as diagnostics or monitoring tools.

If you are a pharmaceutical or research company developing therapeutics or monitoring tools for indications where specific disease-associated antigen and T cell responses are implicated, contact us to discuss development of a highly sensitive Novoleukin Test System specific to your indication.

Name: Endpoints Capital
Description:
Endpoints Capital was founded to address the funding challenges that biotechnology companies face by providing a financing solution that benefits biotechs at all stages. We understand the life sciences ecosystem and the challenges - including financing - that biotech companies face getting their treatment or device into the clinic. This has been further compounded by the difficulties in capital markets in recent times.

We are excited by the opportunity to help biotechs accelerate their discovery of new medicines, therapies and life changing treatments.
Location: Surry Hills, New South Wales, Australia

Name: Ketim Technologies
Description:
Ketim Technologies is building Australia's first protein biomarker blood test to predict a mother's risk of postpartum depression - before symptoms appear.

Built on a proprietary protein biomarker signature (international patent filed) and a globally established diagnostics platform, Ketim is shifting perinatal mental health care from reactive treatment to proactive prevention.

1 in 5 mothers experience postpartum depression. Most go undetected until it's already taken hold. We're changing that - giving clinicians, mothers and families the chance to intervene early, when it matters most.

Name: Denteric Pty Ltd
Description:
Denteric is developing therapies to treat Porphyromonas gingivalis related diseases. Our initial focus is on severe periodontal disease. 

Our vaccine therapy aims to generate antibodies that neutralise the proteolytic toxins of the bacteria that cause periodontal disease and inflammation.  We are currently in phase I clinical trials.

Name: mixOmics Pro
Description:
For 17 years, the open-source mixOmics project has served as a ubiquitous standard in multi-omics analysis, supported by a dedicated team and a global community of over 30,000 researchers.

mixOmics PRO is the next step in this journey, founded and scientifically led by the original creator of mixOmics, Professor Kim-Anh Lê Cao. This evolution places the project on a sustainable footing, ensuring we can continue to serve and support our community for years to come.

Built upon the robust statistical foundations of mixOmics, our PRO platform delivers powerful new capabilities designed to accelerate research:

Advanced Methods
Multiple new methods to solve complex study designs that were previously out of reach for many researchers.

Guided Pipelines
Intuitive, well-documented workflows that replace the need for bespoke scripts, reducing analysis timelines from months to days.

Dedicated Support & Training
Strengthened educational resources and direct access to expert support to help you answer questions with confidence.

Our mission is to sustainably serve and expand our global community. We are building an accessible platform that empowers scientists to uncover deeper insights and achieve faster outcomes.

mixOmics PRO is inspired by and built for the research community. Follow us for news, publications, and educational content.

Name: Prorenata Biotech
Description:
Prorenata Biotech is a biotechnology company developing platforms that enable more flexible, accessible, and scalable manufacturing of advanced genetic medicines.

We focus on the intersection of medical devices, nanomedicine, and translational manufacturing, building systems that are designed for real-world use, quality-by-design, and long-term regulatory readiness. Our work bridges early scientific innovation and practical deployment, with an emphasis on manufacturability, reliability, and impact.

Prorenata Biotech’s mission is to reimagine how complex therapies are produced, moving toward systems that are adaptable, decentralized, and responsive to emerging clinical needs.

Name: MLS Bio (Molecular Life Science Biotech)
Description:
At MLS Bio, we are developing first-in-class small-molecule therapeutics targeting tetraspanins — a novel and underexplored class of cell-surface proteins that play a critical role in cancer progression, metastasis, viral entry and disease biology.

Our lead oncology program, MLS-269, is focused on CD151, a tetraspanin implicated in tumour invasion, migration, epithelial–mesenchymal transition and metastatic spread across multiple solid tumours. By disrupting CD151-mediated cellular signalling and integrin-associated pathways, MLS Bio is advancing a differentiated therapeutic approach designed to address major unmet needs in oncology, with an initial focus on metastatic prostate cancer.

Our proprietary small-molecule platform has generated a pipeline of novel compounds with potential applications across solid tumour oncology and high-impact infectious disease markets. In addition to our oncology focus, MLS Bio is exploring tetraspanin biology in viral disease, including compounds targeting CD81, a host-cell factor involved in viral entry and replication pathways.

MLS Bio brings together a global network of medical researchers, clinicians, commercialisation experts, intellectual property specialists and biotechnology leaders committed to translating breakthrough biology into clinically meaningful therapies. Our programs are supported by an expanding international patent portfolio, leading scientific collaborators and a clear development pathway toward clinical translation.

We are focused on advancing therapies that are mechanistically novel, clinically differentiated and capable of improving outcomes for patients facing cancer and other life-threatening diseases worldwide.

Name: PPB Technology Pty Ltd
Description:
Based on CSIRO’s CYBERTONGUE Technology platform, PPB Technology will be a global leader in point of care diagnostic tests for food, veterinary, agricultural, manufacturing, environmental  and human health applications. 
PPB Technology will enter the market with food diagnostic tests for on the spot analysis of foods, beverages and other biological samples. In an era of uncertainty about food safety, quality and provenance, PPB Technology will give producers, processors and consumers the tools they need to make fast decisions with confidence.

Name: Hexima Limited (ASX:HXL)
Description: Hexima is a clinical stage, anti-infectives focused biotechnology company engaged in the research and development of plant defensin peptides for applications as human therapeutics. Our lead product candidate, pezadeftide (formally HXP124) applied in a topical formulation, is a potential new prescription treatment for toenail fungal infections (or onychomycosis). Hexima is currently conducting an Australian phase IIb clinical trial testing pezadeftide for the treatment of onychomycosis. Hexima holds granted, long-life patents protecting pezadeftide in major markets globally.

Name: Bovotica
Description: Bovotica is developing synbiotic technology to reduce methane emissions from cattle while simultaneously delivering production efficiency.

Name: Victorian Infection and Immunity Network (VIIN)
Description:
The Victorian Infection and Immunity Network (VIIN)'s mission is to promote and grow an inspiring, inclusive network that champions infection and immunity research and education for impactful discoveries and practical health outcomes. 

VIIN provides networking and development opportunities to Victorian infection and immunity researchers through free annual events such as the VIIN Young Investigator Symposium and VIIN Careers Evening, and the annual Lorne Infection and Immunity Conference.

VIIN has operated for over 15 years and has grown to include 15+ Contributing Organisations and 1600+ individual members. Contributing Organisations are the departments, faculties, research institutes and other organisations that provide a financial contribution to VIIN’s annual budget.  Individual members come from VIIN’s Contributing Organisations, as well as other Victorian, Australian and international organisations, or may be unaffiliated to any organisation.

The website at www.viin.org.au contains member profiles, contact details and fields of research, information on relevant news, events, platform technologies, career and funding opportunities. For enquiries contact:  info@viin.org.au

Name: Bionyeri
Description:
Bionyeri is a centre of research and innovation using new technologies to develop new generations of natural products to help relieve symptoms of cancer and pain for a range of health conditions to improve the quality of life and well-being for millions of humans.

Located in Sydney, Australia, we are focused on the advancement of natural products for pain management using resources traditionally used in Western medicine with the assistance of artificial intelligence and enhanced drug discovery mechanisms.

Our vision is to become a market leader in the development of natural products for pain relief which are backed by scientific evidence and experiments conducted from our PC2 accredited laboratory in Sydney, Australia.

Name: TAIK HEALTH | Add Life into Years
Description:
TAIK Health is an Australian science-led longevity platform founded by Professor Hosen Kiat, an internationally recognised cardiologist, researcher and author. We believe that better health begins with better evidence, translating decades of medical research into practical products and education that help people make informed choices every day.

At TAIK, we don’t just add years to life - we add life to years.

Name: Hartwig Medical Foundation Australia
Description: Hartwig Medical Foundation Australia is a not for profit organisation that develops and maintains a comprehensive open source suite of bioinformatic tools to analyse whole genomes and whole transcriptomes for cancer treatment and research. We are a small team of highly skilled software engineers and data scientists with expertise in all aspects of bioinformatics.

Name: Seonix Bio
Description: Seonix Bio's mission is to improve the treatment and prevention of blinding eye disease, through the development of advanced risk prediction tools.

Name: Argent BioPharma
Description:
At Argent BioPharma, we are committed to pioneering the future of healthcare. Our approach is rooted in a profound understanding that advancing medical science is not just about treating diseases but pre-empting and redefining how they are managed. This philosophy guides our R&D efforts, where we focus on the intricate science of the immune system and the exploration of advanced technologies. 

As we progress on this ambitious path, we invite you to follow our journey and be a part of a transformative shift in healthcare. At Argent BioPharma, we're not just changing treatments; we're changing lives.

Name: Marine Biomedical
Description:
Marine Biomedical is an Australian biomaterials company based in Western Australia, developing and manufacturing next-generation, marine-derived solutions for bone regeneration.

Our mission is to unlock the potential of Australia’s marine environment- particularly the pristine waters of the Kimberley coast- to deliver innovative, sustainable medical technologies that improve patient outcomes globally.

At the core of our platform is our proprietary technology, PearlBoneTM- a natural bone graft substitute derived from nacre (mother of pearl). Sourced from the historic pearling industry in Broome, PearlBoneTM represents a unique convergence of sustainability, advanced materials science, and clinical innovation. Once the source of up to 80% of the world’s mother of pearl, Broome’s rich marine heritage now underpins a new frontier in regenerative medicine.

Marine Biomedical is advancing PearlBoneTM through rigorous research, development, and regulatory pathways, with applications across orthopaedic and dental indications. The material’s unique structure supports bone regeneration, positioning it as a promising alternative in a growing global market for bone graft substitutes.

We are building a globally impactful Australian innovation- translating marine-derived biomaterials into real-world healthcare solutions - and welcome collaboration with partners who share our vision for advancing regenerative medicine.

Name: Centor Oceania

Name: Differentia Bio
Description:
Differentia provides knowledge-empowered modeling and simulation services for effective drug development. 
We enable biopharmaceutical companies leveraging our proprietary data, modeling and AI/ML analytics for a deeper understanding of biological systems. Our services accelerate the discovery and delivery of safe and effective therapies to improve healthcare outcomes worldwide. 

We provide model-based solutions for all phases of drug development:
Non-Mechanistic Services:
•	Preclinical: PK/PD animal models, computing therapeutic indices, and facilitating human translation of preclinical data.
•	Phase I: PK/ER models, assessment of random effects, stochastic simulations for FIH dose selection, as well as submission-ready report writing with interpretation.
•	Phase II: Population PK/ER model development, covariate analysis, stochastic simulations for RP2D prediction, as well as submission-ready report writing with interpretation.
•	Phase III: Non-compartmental analysis (NCA) of Phase II data, develop base models for Population PK analysis, conduct covariate analysis, utilize stochastic simulations or Bayesian predictions to support clinical decision-making, and prepare submission-ready reports. 

Mechanistic Services:
•	Preclinical: In vitro binding models, PK(Pharmacokinetics)/RO(Receptor Occupancy)/target engagement predictions, and animal/human translational QSP (Quantitative Systems Pharmacology) disease models.
•	Phase I: PK/RO/target engagement prediction, Sensitivity Analysis, FIH dose/MTD prediction as well as submission-ready report writing with interpretation.
•	Phase II: Efficacious dose/R2PD (Recommended Phase 2 Dose) prediction, sensitivity analysis of parameters, as well as submission-ready report writing with interpretation.
•	Phase III: Individual patient PK fitting, Virtual patient cohort development, variability analysis, patient population stratification, biomarker identification, responder/non-responder analysis

Name: Caladrix
Description:
Caladrix is a CNS-focused biotechnology company pioneering disease-modifying therapeutics for Alzheimer’s and related tauopathies. Founded in 2025, our mission is to harness the brain’s intrinsic clearance pathways—starting with ABCC1, a genetically validated efflux transporter that exports neurotoxic substrates such as amyloid-beta and inflammatory mediators.

Our lead candidate, C-001, is an orally available small molecule designed to activate ABCC1. Unlike monoclonal antibody therapies, C-001 avoids ARIA risk, eliminates the need for infusion clinics, and directly restores the brain’s natural protein homeostasis. Preclinical efficacy, translational biomarker validation, and a successful human PoC study underpin our clinical development strategy.

Caladrix’s Phase 1 trial begins in H1 2026. A 300-patient Phase 2 is slated for 2028. Our pipeline includes candidates for frontotemporal dementia and other tauopathies, as well as modified-release formulations to ensure scalability and adherence.

With a strong IP estate, world-class collaborators, and a scientific team comprising Clarivate’s Highly Cited researchers, Caladrix is positioned to lead the next generation of non-immunologic neurodegenerative therapies.

Melbourne (HQ / Clinical Trials) | Hamburg (R&D) | Palo Alto

Our work supports the transition to net zero emissions, helping industries reduce their environmental impact through microbial biotechnology.

We believe in the power of yeast to transform the way we create, produce, and sustain. Our mission is to develop cutting-edge bioengineering solutions that accelerate the shift towards a low-carbon, circular economy—from sustainable bioproducts to groundbreaking microbial technologies.

Our Vision

We envision a world where biotechnology transforms industries, making them cleaner, more efficient, and more sustainable. By harnessing nature-based innovations, we aim to lead the way in decarbonising key sectors and advancing solutions that work in harmony with the environment.

What We Do
	• Sustainable Bioproducts – Developing eco-friendly alternatives to reduce environmental impact.
	• Microbial Technology – Unlocking the potential of microbes to revolutionise traditional industries.
	• Bioengineering Solutions – Designing scalable biotechnologies that contribute to a net zero future.

Our Community

We are proud to be part of a thriving national biotech ecosystem with support from the CSIRO, but we're firmly rooted in the Hunter region supported by the incredible team at I2N at The University of Newcastle. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, and we work alongside researchers, startups, and industry leaders to accelerate the transition to sustainable, climate-positive technologies.

Join Us

Be part of the movement shaping the future of sustainable biotechnology. Follow Wild Yeast Zoo for the latest breakthroughs and opportunities to get involved.

It’s time to change that.

Our approach is to engineer human cardiac organoids that function similarly to adult human heart tissue, enabling us to directly target therapeutics to the heart. We aim to address the root cause of heart failure and restore heart function.

Name: Implicit Bioscience
Description:
Implicit Bioscience is an unlisted public company based in Brisbane and Seattle. It was founded in 2005 by a number of biopharma veterans including Prof. Peter Andrews AO and Prof. Ian Frazer AC FRS; the company’s mission is to apply groundbreaking immunotherapy to treat serious and life-threatening diseases with few or no effective treatments.

Implicit Bioscience holds worldwide rights to IC14 and is developing it in the new field of immunoneurology for a range of neurodegenerative and neurotraumatic disease indications. IC14 is a biologic monoclonal antibody drug that inactivates CD14 on immune cells and in circulation. CD14 is a master regulator of the immune response that is also a key organiser of responses by the brain’s most common immune cell to infection and injury. Hyper-activated CD14 results in damaging inflammation that kills healthy brain and other cells in diseases such as MND/ALS.

Name: Australasian Proteomics Society
Description:
The Australasian Proteomics Society (APS) aims to promote and facilitate proteomics research and related topics in Australia and New Zealand. Members of the APS are drawn from academic, industry and government laboratories. The APS acts as a liaison body for communication with state and federal governments and a central point for the coordination of proteome-related programmes and resources.

Since 1996 the APS has held an annual scientific symposium each February in Lorne, Victoria, as our flagship meeting. This draws together over 250 delegates from the Australasian region and international invited keynote speakers. We run pre-conference workshops on topical subjects, often delivered by international experts. The annual meeting is well-known for its high-quality science delivered in a relaxed atmosphere and a vibrant social program. At this meeting, scientific vendors play an important role with updates on new instrumentation, workflows, and consumables necessary to advance proteomic research. APS meetings contain symposia dedicated to these topics to recognise the importance of other 'omics techniques. 

The APS, together with other learned societies, co-organises local, national and international meetings within the region, as well as workshops and other forums for the exchange of proteomics advances and techniques. Examples include APS’s hosting of the 2019 HUPO world congress in Adelaide and regional HUPO meetings. APS highly values the involvement of student members (SoAPS - Students of Australasian Proteomics Society) and offers financial support through low-cost registration, travelling fellowships, and scientific awards. Our annual meeting has a dedicated session for oral presentations from student members.

Servatus has two drug research platforms: Engineered proteins for the treatment of autoimmune diseases, and microbial biotherapeutics for the treatment of inflammatory conditions and bacterial infections.

Our protein research focuses on improving specific characteristics of existing therapeutic proteins. We carefully select proteins with clear clinical utility, and through rational redesign of key features, we improve bioavailbility and biological potency. We then rapidly clone and express the proteins in amounts suitable for clinical use, thus providing faster, more effective treatment of chronic auto immune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis, with fewer undesirable side effects.

In parallel with our protein work, we also develop live microbial biotherapeutic treatments for microbiome-associated conditions, including but not limited to inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), arthritis, atopic dermatitis, and gastrointestinal infections (for example, C. diff and H.pylori infections). We utilise bacterial strains that have not been widely employed previously, but have demonstrated bioactive properties in the latest scientific research. These bacteria have been shown to inhibit pathogenic bacterial growth and infection, modulate immune responses, and regulate inflammatory signals. Bacterial candidates are developed to act directly at specific sites to treat specific ailments and diseases.

Servatus currently holds patents for numerous microbial biotherapeutics and engineered proteins for autoimmune disease treatments

Servatus Ltd derives its name from the patron saint St Servatus, a 4th century churchman and diplomat, who was invoked as a saint for his healing powers for a range of ailments.

Name: ARC Centre of Excellence in Quantum Biotechnology (QUBIC)
Description:
The ARC Centre of Excellence in Quantum Biotechnology (QUBIC) is the first national Centre globally at the interface of quantum and biological science. We aim to create a unique, vibrant, multidisciplinary environment for transformational, collaborative research at the very cutting edge.

The Centre has nodes at The University of Queensland, The University of Melbourne, the University of Technology Sydney, the University of Wollongong and Flinders University. 

The ARC Centre of Excellence in Quantum Biotechnology (QUBIC) aims to pioneer paradigm-shifting quantum technologies to observe biological processes and transform our understanding of life.

We seek to drive fundamental knowledge and innovation across manufacturing, clean energy, agriculture, health and national security.

Our research program is developing quantum technologies that go far beyond what is possible today, from portable brain imagers to superfast single protein sensors.

We are using this technology to unravel complex, multiscale challenges in biotechnology, including how enzymes catalyse reactions and how higher brain function emerges from networks of neurons.

In close partnership with industry and government, we are working to build Australia’s quantum economy and train a future quantum workforce.

Name: Concr
Description:
[Multi-modal data] + [FarrSight Bayesian Platform] = "What if?" Digital Twin Simulations

Name: Myrio Tx
Description:
Cancer will have no place to hide...
Myrio Therapeutics ("Myrio Tx") is about to revolutionize the field of immuno-oncology by enabling antibody-based therapies to attack targets that are inside cells such as mutated cancer-causing and viral proteins. Proteins inside cells are routinely broken down into peptides which are displayed on the cell surface by Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC), the targets of T-Cells. Myrio Tx’s protein-display system can discover antibodies against difficult to hit targets such as peptide-MHC complexes. This ability increases the number of addressable cancer or viral targets by a factor of ten. Based on fully-human sequences, discovered antibodies can be formatted to fit any purpose, from targeting CAR-T cells, antibody-drug conjugates, bispecifics or traditional antibodies.

Myrio Tx's discovery platform can generate high affinity (low nM/pM) and highly selective scFv (antibody fragments) in a matter of days, allowing for rapid evaluation and optimization of product candidates. Myrio Tx is seeking partnerships to fully exploit the potential of its technology whilst also building an in-house portfolio of products.

Neurotech International Limited (ASX: NTI) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for paediatric neurological and neurodevelopmental disorders.

The Company’s lead drug candidate, NTI164, is a non-intoxicating, pharmaceutical-grade, broad-spectrum oral cannabinoid drug therapy being advanced through established clinical and regulatory pathways.

In Rett syndrome, NTI164 has received Orphan Drug Designation and Rare Pediatric Disease Designation from the US FDA. The Company is expanding its Rett syndrome program to further characterise the mechanism of action of NTI164 in human neuronal models, following completion of a Phase I clinical study.

In PANDAS/PANS, clinical and mechanistic data have been published in the peer-reviewed journal Neurotherapeutics, supporting continued development in this severe neuroimmune disorder.

Neurotech is also advancing IND- and TGA-enabling safety studies to support long-term clinical development and regulatory interactions in both Australia and the United States.

Name: Island Pharmaceuticals
Description:
Islands Pharmaceuticals is a drug repurposing company, focused on areas of unmet need for antiviral therapeutics to address infectious diseases.

We have a lead asset – ISLA-101 - that was initially developed by our wholly owned subsidiary, Isla Pharmaceuticals. ISLA-101 is a drug with a well-established safety profile, being repurposed for the prevention and treatment of dengue fever and other mosquito (or vector) borne diseases.

Dengue fever is the very definition of an unmet medical need. While 400 million humans are infected each year, it is thought that around 30-50% people with the disease do not present with symptoms, enabling the virus to spread within communities. Warming global climates are accelerating the presence of mosquito-borne viruses that can cause death to the Americas, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, Europe and the Pacific Islands.

There is no specific pharmaceutical treatment and the one vaccine which exists is available to a highly restricted audience. 

Island has repurposed ISLA-101, an antiviral oral drug to treat mosquito-borne viruses (eg dengue fever / Zika) and has commenced a Phase 2a/b Challenge clinical trial, incorporating both prophylactic (preventative) and therapeutic (treatment) arms across two cohorts.

Island is also focused on expanding its pipeline, and the Company is currently exploring the potential acquisition of a second antiviral molecule asset, called galidesivir, from BioCryst (NASDAQ: BCRX).

Galidesivir is a clinical stage antiviral molecule that has shown antiviral activity against over 20 RNA viruses, including Ebola, Zika and Marburg viruses.

The test is commercially available in the USA through its high complexity CLIA testing lab in Maryland and in Australia via Sonic Healthcare’s pathology network.  The company is in discussions re-launching the test in other territories.

Name: Cell Bauhaus
Description: Cell Bauhaus builds software to enable computer aided design of living systems. Our virtual cell technology helps bring synthetic biology products to market faster and cheaper.

Name: The Advanced Genomics Collaboration (TAGC)
Description:
Illumina and The University of Melbourne have partnered to create a biomedical and economic powerhouse for Australia—The Advanced Genomics Collaboration.

TAGC enables multi-disciplinary collaborations to use the power of genomics to create world-leading, commercially successful biomedical projects and businesses that make healthcare more effective, efficient and affordable for everyone.

TAGC is helping to enable greater levels of genomics research and clinical trials throughout the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct by providing our collaborators with access to faster, more affordable genome sequencing, global-scale bioinformatics and insightful health economics resources. 

TAGC is committed to helping all our collaborators use genomics to improve health for everyone while supporting the creation of commercially successful biotech businesses through access to Illumina's team of industry and commercialisation experts.

Name: Plant Synthetic Biology Australia
Description: PSBA will provide plant synthetic biology services for agricultural species, including oilseed and cereal crops, as well as model species to bio-manufacture materials, medicines and other high-value products. It provides infrastructure and expertise for research providers, government and industry institutions as fee-for-service as well as providing incubation space for the start-up community and opportunities to collaborate. PSBA provides capability across the synthetic biology cycle including the design of molecular componentry, genetic editing and transformation, and the phenotypic evaluation of the bio-designed plants.

Name: Genomical
Description:
Genomical is Australia’s only software-as-a-service platform for end-to-end management of genomic health data. It has supported large-scale genomic testing across Victoria for over seven years, across both inherited conditions and cancer.
With over 25,000 tests performed across six accredited laboratories, Genomical is a proven, road-hardened solution — now available nationally through Transcendomics.

Name: Cell Care Australia
Description:
Cell Care is Australia’s largest and most experienced cord blood and tissue stem cell bank.

We collect process and store umbilical cord blood and tissue to provide potential medical treatment options for Australian families.

At Cell Care we invest in driving market awareness through multiple consumer and health care professional channels. Our clinical trials investment program supports local Australian research into potential new indications for cord blood including type 1 diabetes and cerebral palsy. 

We are a dynamic and innovative Australian owned company with passionate employees who love what they do.

Name: RNA Innovation Foundry
Description: RNA Innovation Foundry (RIF) focuses on manufacturing quality mRNA suitable for pre-clinical research, negating the need for individual laboratories to establish and maintain their own production. The facility will provide scale-up manufacturing capacity for RNA products to Australian customers and support therapeutic research translation.

Name: VivaZome Therapeutics
Description:
VivaZome Therapeutics Pty Ltd is a privately-held Australian biotech company, with operational headquarters at the Bio Innovation Hub at La Trobe University in Melbourne, Australia. VivaZome is developing and will commercialise customised EV-based therapies for debilitating and life-threatening disorders, with a focus on neurological conditions, especially Traumatic Brain Injury and associated Post-Traumatic Epilepsy, stroke and dementia.
VivaZome is developing new technologies, intellectual property and manufacturing processes that apply generically to EV therapies.  These underpin the Company’s development of specific EV products for its target indications. The VivaZome team has extensive expertise in the development and commercialisation of biological therapies, together with a wide network of expert contacts in the Australian and global biotech communities.
VivaZome acknowledges the support of the Department of Industry and Science through the CRC-P program, and the contribution of its CRC-P partners: University of Queensland, La Trobe University, Cytiva and SeerPharma Pty Ltd.
For more information, please visit www.vivazome.com

Name: New Edge Microbials
Description:
NEM is Australia's largest producer of biological inoculants and research provider committed to harnessing the best science to support sustainable farming and a healthier planet.

As an Australian nature-tech pioneer, we are mission driven to use the best science to support sustainable farming and a healthier planet. 

Our sophisticated R&D platform is building an enduring legacy for agriculture, reduced dependence on imported synthetic inputs and a thriving R&D ecosystem. 

WE invest $5 million per year out of our profits into four priority areas:
 Promoting plant growth
 Increasing nitrogen and phosphorus uptake
 Reducing abiotic stress in a drying climate
 Increasing soil carbon

To leverage every dollar, NEM draws on collaboration and commercialisation partnerships with leading centres of Australian soil science and biotechnology, including the CSIRO, and five eminent natural sciences universities. 

We've secured exclusive agricultural rights to one of the world's largest known microbial libraries, containing more than 450,000 soil microbes from thousands of samples taken across Australia. This amounts to over 40 years of research by pre-eminent Australian soil scientists, which puts us ahead of the curve. 

NEM commands 45% of the Australian market for biologicals in legumes, with growing export markets in South America, The United States and Europe.  

A decade ago biologicals was a $100 million global industry, now its $10 billion and climbing to $25 billion by 2030. 

NEM products are proudly manufactured in Albury, regional NSW. Our facility provides over 60 skilled jobs and our $15m expansion (co-funded through the Modern Manufacturing Initiative) will provide more jobs for regional employment that keeps talented people in the regions.

Name: Gertrude Biomedical
Description:
At Gertrude Biomedical our strategy is focused on modulating key gene 'switches' also known as transcription factors. This approach has the potential to identify novel therapeutics to treat diseases of unmet medical need. 
Gertrude Biomedical is dedicated to developing novel small molecule inhibitors of the SOX18 transcription factor complex, targeting genes that build blood & lymphatic vessels. This approach 'short circuits' the gene programs that promote pathological vessels in disease, providing the potential to treat human diseases that depend on aberrant vasculature for their growth and spread.

Name: NeoGenix Biosciences pty ltd
Description:
We are NeoGenix. A med-tech startup that supports  fertility treatment. 
We want your journey to building a family to be filled with joy. That is why we create effective, safe, biologically inspired devices to help IVF specialists  bring out the best in your fertility treatment.

Name: Biosion
Description:
Biosion is a global R&D biotechnology company committed to developing antibody-based therapies to improve patient outcomes for the treatment of immune and oncologic diseases. 

Established in 2017, Biosion has built a pipeline of innovative biologics through its internally derived technologies including the H3 antibody discovery, SynTracerTM HT-endocytosis and FlexibodyTM bispecific platforms. Biosion's lead asset, BSI-045B (anti-TSLP mAb), is currently in four clinical trials, with the most advanced already in Phase 3. Biosion and partners have plans to progress additional assets into the clinic for oncology indications over the next year. 

Biosion has operations in the US, Australia, and China. 
To learn more about Biosion visit www.biosion.com.

Name: Currus Biologics Pty Ltd
Description:
Currus Biologics is developing its proprietary BEAT (Bispecific Engagers of Antigen Presenting Cells and T cells) platform to unlock CAR T-cell therapy for solid tumours.

The BEAT (Bispecific Engagers of Antigen presenting cells and T cells) is a universal solution compatible with any CAR T-cell format or tumour target, able to rewire immune activation by simultaneously engaging antigen-presenting cells (APCs) and CAR T-cells to overcome the biological barriers that have limited CAR T-cell efficacy in solid tumours. 

The Company’s approach prevents CAR T-cell exhaustion, drives durable proliferation and persistence, remodels the tumour microenvironment, and promotes epitope spreading, enabling robust and sustained anti-tumour responses.

Supported by robust preclinical data and independent academic validation, the BEAT technology provides a cost-effective, flexible add-on, enabling partners to unlock their technology and deliver life-changing outcomes for patients. 
 
Currus Biologics is a privately held biotechnology company based in Melbourne, Australia, backed by Brandon Capital Partners, Main Sequence Ventures, and Uniseed.

Name: Syd Biotechnologies
Description:
Welcome to Syd Biotechnologies, where we proudly serve as your dedicated distributor at the forefront of biotech innovation. Our primary mission is to bridge the gap between researchers, scientists, and the cutting-edge advancements in biotechnology. As distributors, we play a pivotal role in ensuring that high-quality products and services from esteemed industry leaders reach those who are pushing the boundaries of scientific discovery.

Our distinctiveness lies in our unwavering passion for science and our steadfast commitment to excellence in distribution. We recognize the ever-evolving landscape of biotech and are here to facilitate collaboration, discovery, and transformation. At Syd Biotechnologies, we invite you to embark on a transformative journey with us. Together, we can shape the future of biotechnology, fostering innovation and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. Explore our extensive range of offerings, connect with like-minded individuals, and join us in this exciting exploration of scientific excellence. Syd Biotechnologies – your trusted distributor and partner in biotech innovation.

Some of our key Products and Services are:
Custom PhIP-Seq Service for Profiling of Autoantibodies
Custom Flowcytometry Services
Custom UV Circular Dichroism Spectroscopy
Custom Protein Purification

Double Stranded RNA Isolation Kits
Total RNA Isolation Kits
